subject: Cash-apply ledger anchoring & VAT origin trace for NebulaSoft account
messages:
From: Marie Chen <marie.chen@nebulasoft.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-06-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Reconciliation hit after ERP cutover: sample attached

Hannah —

Hope you're well. After our ERP cutover last week we did an initial AR reconcile and found a cluster of unapplied credits and mismatched VAT tags for May invoices (invoice series NS-2027-05-*). The AP team forwarded a sample ledger (attached) showing remittances applied to the wrong billing entity and, in a few cases, payments that cleared without VAT provenance stored on the invoice record.

This is causing two issues on our side: (1) unapplied credits aging up in our AR report, and (2) VAT reporting variance for a handful of cross-border invoices. Can you help trace the origin and advise on a corrective path (journal entries and whether we need a contracted credit note)?

I've attached sampling-ledger.csv and flagged three invoice IDs in the sheet. Happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Thanks,
Marie Chen
Finance Lead, NebulaSoft
marie.chen@nebulasoft.com

Attachment: sampling-ledger.csv (CSV sample, 63 rows)

Marie — thanks for the sample and the clear callout. Looping in Grace, Laura and Ben from our finance/ops team so we can get a full cash-apply audit and confirm the VAT provenance.

Plan (first pass):
- We will run an automated cash-apply trace against the remittance IDs you provided.
- Grace to check which billing entities were used by the application job during the migration window.
- Laura to draft journal entry templates we can post once we confirm misapplies.
- Ben to coordinate a clearing-run and reconcile unapplied credits.

I'll share an initial finding by end of day PST and a proposed remediation schedule. Thanks for flagging this — we'll prioritize.

Best,

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-06-18T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: NebulaSoft cashapply audit scope and JE stub

Team —

Quick operational ask and suggested steps to keep audit trail intact:

1) Audit sweep (Grace): run cash-apply audit for remittance range 20270601-20270610. Produce a CSV with columns: remittance_id, invoice_id, applied_amt, original_pay_date, applied_entity, vat_code_original, vat_code_applied, remittance_method, source_file. Compare against sampling-ledger.csv.

2) Journal approach (Laura): if we confirm misapplies where payment was posted to the wrong billing entity but cash is present, propose JE:
   - DR Bank (by entity)  
   - CR Suspense-CashApply-NEBULA
   - Then DR Suspense-CashApply-NEBULA  
   - CR Revenue (correct entity)  
   Include VAT columns if tax footprint differs. Keep JE ID placeholder JE-NEB-XXXX.

3) Clearing (Ben): schedule a targeted clearing-run tonight to apply unapplied credits where customer confirmation exists. Produce auditable-trace.pdf (export of pre/post ledger rows) to attach to the JE.

4) VAT provenance (ALL): if vat_code_original is blank for any applied invoice, we must not post automatic VAT-bearing revenue movements until we get external support (credit note or remap). For cross-border cases, mark for manual review and include a note for tax.

Timeline: initial audit results by EOD today, clearing run tonight, JE posting tomorrow morning (06/19) once Laura signs off.

Attachments to use for evidence: vat-mapping.xlsx, sampling-ledger.csv

Thanks — Hannah

Note: Please add any missing remittance IDs to the drive folder before 4pm PST so they get included in tonight's run.

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-06-19T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: NebulaSoft cashapply audit scope and JE stub

All — ran the targeted clearing-run at 02:00 UTC this morning against the remittance window. Summary of findings (high level):

- 48 remittances processed; 9 were applied to the wrong billing entity (legacy entity tag used during migration).
- 6 invoices had missing VAT provenance (vat_code_original blank) — these are cross-border and flagged for manual tax review.
- Created JE-3581 (draft) to move cash from Suspense-CashApply-NEBULA to correct revenue ledgers for the 9 misapplies. Attached auditable-trace.pdf (pre/post rows + remittance audit).

Next steps enacted:
- Pushed clearing corrections for 39 remittances that had direct match rules.
- Left 9 misapplies pending manual post by Laura (to ensure entity-level posting).
- Flagged 6 VAT-blank invoices for tax team query (Grace to own).

I will hand off auditable-trace.pdf and the JE draft to Laura for posting.

Ben Carter
Finance Operations - Cash Application
Redwood Inference

Attachment: auditable-trace.pdf
Journal draft: JE-3581-draft (in Drive)

- Drafted JE-3581 (attached) to move cash from Suspense-CashApply-NEBULA to correct revenue ledgers for the 9 misapplies. Laura is queued to post the JE tomorrow morning after a final sign-off.
